publication_context: Projection from 2026Q3 data, generated after that quarter ended

selection_policy.primary_metric: pooled native-unit MAE on common eligible rows
selection_policy.alpha_selection: 2024 validation only; minimum MAE, then smaller alpha
selection_policy.method_selection: 2024 validation only; minimum MAE, ties naive then seasonal then Ridge
selection_policy.test_policy: Freeze alpha, method and gates before test. Expand fits using labels known at each origin.
selection_policy.cohort: Dynamic origin-only eligibility; at least configured min_training_pairs known supported training pairs. No future survival gate.
selection_policy.scoring: All compared methods use the same rows. Next actual must satisfy the declared target support rule.
selection_policy.fallback: Current supported level and >=min_fallback_quarters valid quarters; no stale-level carry forward. Never used in fair-cohort metrics.

transformations.sales_count: log1p target and historical levels, expm1 inverse; clamp negative count predictions to zero
transformations.weighted_geomean_monthly_median_aed_m2: log target and historical levels, exp inverse; nonpositive/nonfinite predictions unavailable

population.universe: Every segment with a supplied scoped row between panel_start and origin, including unsupported segments
population.subtypes: Retained as source cells; blank subtype remains missing, distinct from literal labels

eligibility.count: All three segment months observed; sums exact for supplied rows. Zero requires numeric observed zero rows.
eligibility.price: Count quarter supported, >=min_price_sales, all three months priced, >=min_price_coverage
eligibility.history_quarters: Number of supported target quarters from panel_start through origin
eligibility.last_actual: Supported origin-quarter target only; null if unsupported, never stale
eligibility.price_coverage: Origin positive-median cell count weights / observed counts; blank for count and zero denominator
eligibility.provisional: Latest 1 historical quarter(s); source corrections remain possible

target_definitions.sales_count: Sum transaction_count for supplied Unit/Villa Sales cells in a supported area/registration quarter
target_definitions.weighted_geomean_monthly_median_aed_m2: exp(sum(n_i * log(p_i)) / sum(n_i)) over positive monthly median_price_per_m2_aed, weighted by transaction_count

status_definitions.ok: Validation-selected method on primary supported cohort
status_definitions.fallback: Predeclared supported-current-level naive fallback; outside common evaluation cohort
status_definitions.insufficient_data: Inputs exist but history or price-support gates fail
status_definitions.missing_input: Origin lacks three observed months or usable price inputs

source_evidence.raw_provenance: Source filenames, hashes and catalogue references are upstream reports; Part 3 has not independently rehashed or authenticated the raw exports.
source_evidence.extraction_scope: Observed dates are not proof of the requested export period, query filters, or complete retrieval of all parts.
source_evidence.market_completeness: Not established. Aggregate reconciliation and observed months do not prove complete market coverage.
source_evidence.field_limits: Monthly cells retain counts, medians and subtypes but omit transaction IDs, procedure and transaction-level valid-price denominators.
evidence_needed: Recorded export query dates, filters and source version or revision timestamp.
An authenticated export manifest listing every part or page, its row count and hash.
Reconciliation of the complete raw export and documented exclusions to authoritative totals for the same scope.
Upstream confirmation of missing-month semantics; archived release vintages for true real-time backtesting.

source_coverage_note: Only supplied records; completeness is not established.
warnings: Only supplied records; completeness is not established. Three observed months is a support rule, not proof of full coverage.
Missing rows are unknown, never inferred zero. Unobserved property/subtype cells may remain within observed segment months.
Price is a count-weighted geometric mean of positive monthly medians, not a pooled quarterly median or mix-adjusted index.
Price weight coverage is a support proxy, not transaction-level valid-price coverage.
Unit/Villa can include commercial units. No procedure filter is available.
Pseudo-real-time backtests use today's revised snapshot, not historical release vintages.
Inverse log predictions are not automatically unbiased arithmetic means. No prediction intervals are estimated.

Fallback history/input policy is evaluated separately; historical sample-limited errors do not guarantee accuracy for every segment or future quarter. Numerical model-failure fallbacks are not evaluated.
Fractional sales_count values are continuous numerical forecasts of activity, not literal fractional transactions; CSV precision is retained.
Recorded sales activity is not buyer enquiries, agent demand, profit or a guarantee.
2026Q4 is projected from data up to the end of 2026Q3; later records in the source are excluded.

fallback_evaluation.scope: Input/history-driven fallback policy, evaluated separately from the primary common-row cohort
fallback_evaluation.runtime_failure_fallbacks: Not evaluated here; numerical model failures are outside this support-policy experiment
limitations: Historical, sample-limited evidence; no guarantee for an individual segment or the operational quarter.
Validation and test cohorts vary by origin and differ from the final operational fallback list.
Revised source snapshot rather than historical vintages; completeness remains unverified.
Origin and segment observations are dependent; price scores exclude unsupported next-quarter prices.
